headword: {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}

definitions.gloss: firefighter; member of a firefighting unit
definitions.explanation: A professional member of a fire brigade whose job is to put out fires and carry out rescues. Formed from {消防|しょうぼう} (firefighting) and {隊員|たいいん} (unit member).

examples.japanese: {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The firefighters arrived at the scene.

examples.japanese: {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{救|すく}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The firefighter pulled a person out of the smoke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After receiving the fire report, the firefighters were dispatched at once.

notes:
A paid professional attached to a ⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧ (fire station), as opposed to a volunteer in a ⟦{消防団|しょうぼうだん}→消防団：29795_shouboudan⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the firefighters are dispatched
- {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a firefighter
- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧な{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}: a brave firefighter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消防士|しょうぼうし}→消防士：05057_shouboushi⟧: firefighter — the more common everyday term for the occupation.
- ⟦{消防団|しょうぼうだん}→消防団：29795_shouboudan⟧: volunteer fire corps — community volunteers, not full-time staff.
